title: VIX spike -> FDX next-day bounce
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] VIX daily log return spike predicts a next-day mean-reversion bounce in FedEx after panic selling (+); trade long FDX 1d at 1d lag [finance.^VIX.log_return -> finance.FDX.log_return]
message: Not supported: VIX spike -> FDX next-day bounce fails (lag-1 r~0, OOS hit 30%, avg -0.2%); only a contemporaneous r=-0.48 (FDX falls with VIX same day). Actionability 1.77.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.^VIX.log_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long FDX next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Reversal: VIX log-return spike (20d z > 1) shows no next-day FDX bounce (OOS hit 30%), so test continuation instead (-); trade short FDX 2d at 1d lag [finance.^VIX.log_return -> finance.FDX.log_return] (parent: R2-0176)
